text:
claire_ae: Kicking off Pulse POC perf thread. Customer acceptance: 1k qps sustained, p95 end-to-end < 120ms, p99 < 300ms, and proof of KMS/HSM behavior for SOC. Also want a simple multi-region failover smoke. Need runbook + POC hourly estimate.
devin_eng: Got it. Recommend rdx-6b-fp16 for headroom at 1k qps. Dedicated capacity across two regions (us-west/us-east) so we can demo failover. Typical payloads: ~360 tokens in, ~140 out.
harper_sre: Sizing: start with 16 nodes spread 8/region (autoscale off). Warmup: 10m prefix+kv priming per region. Steady: 30m, then simulate region failover by draining us-west at minute 40 and observe failover to us-east. Include a 10% burst to 1200 qps for 5m to validate headroom.
isla_sec: KMS modes we'll demo: no-encrypt, envelope-cache (recommended), strict-unwrap (audit-mode). For HSM attestation we can provide CloudHSM or on-prem HSM artifacts on request. We'll also include audit log forwarding instructions (CloudTrail -> customer SIEM).
claire_ae: Can we get a minimal load plan and an example command I can forward to the customer? Also rough $ impact for encryption and cross-region egress.
devin_eng: Load plan: ramp 0->1000 qps over 12m, sustain 30m, burst 5m @1200 qps, drain region A to simulate failover for 5m, teardown 3m. Use Poisson arrivals, 40 clients across 4 generator boxes. Collect p50/p90/p95/p99, gpu/cpu util, kv cache hit rate, network egress, and failover latency.
devin_eng: Fortio smoke (example per region):
```
fortio load -qps=500 -t=45m -c=20 http://rg-west/loadgen/oxide/generate -payload=payload.json > fortio_west.out
fortio load -qps=500 -t=45m -c=20 http://rg-east/loadgen/oxide/generate -payload=payload.json > fortio_east.out
```
We'll run combined 1000 qps by running both. For strict KMS unwrap we'll set KMS_STRICT_UNWRAP=true on the cluster.
runbot: perf-job-pulse-1789123456 started on ded-multi-1 (us-west/us-east).
harper_sre: Warm cache run (both regions warm): baseline (no-encrypt) combined p95 ~= 95ms, p99 ~= 240ms. Envelope-cache combined p95 ~= 118ms, p99 ~= 285ms. Strict-unwrap combined p95 ~= 165ms, p99 ~= 420ms. During failover (us-west drained) p95 spike to ~160ms for ~30s while routing and caches warm, then settles ~130ms.
claire_ae: Nice — please turn that into a short cost sketch: hourly POC + $/1M tokens deltas and note cross-region egress. Customer cares about egress charges.
harper_sre: Cost sketch: node example $3.25/hr -> 16 nodes = $52/hr. Baseline token compute infra ~ $1.10 per 1M tokens. Envelope-cache overhead ~+13% -> ~$+0.14 per 1M tokens. Strict-unwrap ~+36% -> ~$+0.40 per 1M tokens (includes KMS egress + latency penalties). Cross-region egress observed ~ 120GB for the failover step in the run -> estimate ~$10-25 depending on cloud. Will include a clear line item.
isla_sec: Draft QA snippet for their security team: "Key ownership: customer-managed CMKs in their KMS/HSM. Redwood performs envelope encryption; ephemeral envelope keys are cached per-node to meet latency SLOs. Unwrap operations are performed by the customer's KMS; all key unwrap and access events are logged and forwarded to the customer's audit endpoint. Envelope keys rotate every 24h by default; CMK rotation follows customer's KMS policy. For clients requiring FIPS/HSM, we support CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, or on-prem HSMs and can provide attestation artifacts upon request."
claire_ae: Action items: devin run the three full variants and upload run-report + graphs, harper to produce the hourly POC quote and egress line items, isla to paste the QA snippet in the questionnaire and confirm how to forward logs. I'll send to the customer after artifacts land.
devin_eng: Warmup script (used): `./scripts/warm_kv.sh --prefixes=20000 --clients=40 --duration=10m`
runbot: perf-job-pulse-1789123456 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/pulse/1789123456/{fortio_west.out,fortio_east.out,run-report.pdf,gpu-cpu-metrics.tar.gz} 
claire_ae: Thanks team  I'll assemble the AE pack. If customer asks for longer soak or HSM attestation, we'll schedule a follow-up run. :thumbsup:
